title: devx sdk todo scratchpad
content:
Quick daily scratchpad - SDK docs / sample app gaps

Context:
- Goal: reduce onboarding friction for engineers using Redwood API (hosted + dedicated + private). Focus on concrete sample apps and minimal, copy-paste examples.
- Pain: docs currently assume too much infra context; streaming + function-calling examples are scattered / incomplete. Embeddings batch example missing for Python.

Top priorities (short):
- [ ] Create a 10-min TS quickstart (Next.js) that demonstrates: basic text generation, streaming responses, and function/tool calling fallback. Make it single-file where possible.
- [ ] Add a Python embeddings batch + upsert example (small dataset) showing rate limits & retry pattern.
- [ ] Write a short note on quantization/latency tradeoffs for devx blog / faq page (target: 300-500 words).
- [ ] Update streaming doc to include reconnect behavior and resume token handling (edge cases).

Notes / rough ideas:
- Quickstart (TS) outline:
  1) Install -> npm i @redwood/inference (or yarn)
  2) Basic usage: import Client, example request (20 lines)
  3) Streaming: show onmessage handler + UI append; include abort controller example
  4) Function calling: define function schema, call model with tool, handle tool response -> show fallback when tool unavailable (use simple math/tool).
  5) Deploy note: host using Vercel, env var REDWOOD_API_KEY and region.

- Python embeddings: show batch size tweak (default 16), backoff on 429, small code to upsert to pinecone/redis (pseudo). Call out cost per-embedding and how to estimate.

Doc gaps I've seen in review: 
- "retry semantics" section incomplete for streaming (concurrency + idempotency guidance).
- "Private deployment quickstart" lacks KMS/HSM examples; add note about key rotation + audit logs link.
- "Dedicated capacity best practices" needs recommended batching settings for common seq lengths (e.g., chat with 2-3 messages average).

Unresolved questions (ask infra/research):
- Should we recommend a default quantization profile for small-medium LLMs on Dedicated? (ping Applied ML)
- Is there a supported SDK pattern for pinned model version + local fallback when Private control plane unreachable? (ops/SRE)

Small TODOs (low effort):
- [ ] Add `response_tokens` sampling example (temp param) to generation doc.
- [ ] Fix the example response JSON in streaming doc: missing final newline.
- [ ] Add link to canary rollout dashboard (Console) in rollouts doc.
- [ ] Create one-liner copy for README: "Redwood SDK: production-first inference client (streams, embeddings, tools)."

Possible sample app ideas (pick one):
- Minimal chat app with streaming + message history persisted in SQLite. Pros: shows tokens & latency.
- Search + rerank demo: embed corpus, query embedding, rerank with a small instruction prompt. Pros: ties embeddings -> generation.
- Local fallback sample: show how to configure SDK to fall back to a smaller local model when hosted rate limited. Needs infra input.

UX notes for docs: 
- Keep code examples <= 30 lines where possible. Developers want copy-paste.
- Add "playground" permalink links to the top of each tutorial for quick try-out.
- For errors: give 3 common fixes per error code (401, 429, 500).

Links to reference artifacts (for follow-up):
- Draft quickstart PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/245 (Samantha started this, needs streaming + tests)
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEV/SDK+Quickstart+Draft
- Jira: INFR-9876 (streaming reconnects), CONC-1452 (private deployment KMS docs)

Notes to self / next steps:
- Block 90m to implement TS quickstart skeleton. Pair with Samantha for streaming bits.
- Drop a note to Mikaela to add quantization guidance from Applied ML review.
- Tag PR with "docs/quickstart" and request review from product-docs.

Rough timeline:
- TS quickstart + streaming doc update: this week (target: 2026-03-06)
- Python embeddings example + retry guidance: next week (target: 2026-03-12)
- Quantization short note + link in ded. best practices: sync with Applied ML (target: 2026-03-16)

Random ideas captured (brain dump):
- Tiny CLI tool: `rw-infer` that wraps common flows (gen/embeddings/stream) for local testing. Could be super useful for SRE and new hires.
- Add a short section "when to use Dedicated vs Hosted" with simple rule-of-thumb bullet points for docs homepage.

-- end scratchpad --

TODO: convert top-priority items into issues in repo and link back here.
